note: 32 PDF sheets whose running header prints "Team 52849 MCM/ICM Page N of 31", so printed page = PDF page - 1; the printed document is 31 pages, references run on printed 20-22 and the appendix (code listings for the algorithmic and NetLogo models) fills printed 23-31, which is why the last nine sheets hold no exhibit at all. 12 measured regions on 8 pages - 3, 4, 5, 9, 13, 15, 16, 17 - and every one is an exhibit, so 10 figure rows and 2 table rows with nothing excluded and nothing unaccounted. The layout pass also reports 23 vector paths on p6 with no bounding region; the page carries the four display-equation blocks headed "Change in residential water:", "Change in locked water:", "Change in available water:" and "Change in potable water:", which are typeset maths rather than an exhibit, so they are noted here instead of being forced into the exclusion ledger. Numbering is both thin and broken: only eight numbers are ever printed, always as "Figure N:", and Figure 6 and Figure 8 do not exist anywhere in the document, so the sequence runs 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9, 10. Two exhibits print no number and no caption at all - the discipline/relevance table at the top of p3 and the six-column interventions table at the top of p5 - and four figure panels carry a number only through their partner: Figure 7 and Figure 9 each print as a left/right raster pair on p16, captioned once under the row, so p16 contributes four rows over two printed numbers. Caption placement is uniform in the one place it exists: all seven printed captions sit below their artwork, the two uncaptioned tables record the house above. The exhibits themselves are a mixed bag - Figure 1 is a pair of UNEP choropleths whose legends sit inside the art and whose panels are labelled only by the caption; Figures 2 and 3 are diagrams rather than plots, a Vensim stock-and-flow network of eight stocks and twelve valves and a three-box algorithm flowchart; Figure 4 is a NetLogo interface screenshot whose node labels overprint into illegibility; and Figures 5, 7, 9 and 10 are one chart template exported five times - three hand-styled bars with a stacked three-line y title, no numeric y ticks, no legend and the values printed above the bars - with the sole exception being the lower-right panel of p16, an Excel line chart with a real numeric axis, a keyed legend and no value labels, printed beside the bar chart it is supposed to be comparable with. Citation is the weakest in this batch: no body sentence anywhere names a figure or a table, and the only three pointers in 31 pages are deictic - "as shown below" closing section 1.2 for the p3 table, "in relation to the system above" on p6 for the Vensim diagram (the one citation that follows its figure, lead_pages -1), and "as shown below" on p13 for the NetLogo screenshot; Figure 10's caption still carries the unfilled "??fill what we ran for degrees" placeholder, so the paper went to print with a drafting marker visible.
